resolved.title: 简单运算
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Simple Operations[/h1][/s0l0!-header]

So Python can spell, but can it count? Let’s talk about calculations.
Doing a calculation in Python is simple, just enter it into the [b]print[/b] statement (don’t forget the parentheses!):
[code format="py" codeId="3890"]print(2 + 2)
print(5 + 4 - 3)[/code]
[note]See the spaces around the plus and minus signs? The code would work without them–but they make it a lot easier to read.[/note]

resolved.title: 简单操作符
resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Simple Operations[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Multiplication and division in Python are also pretty simple. We use an [b]asterisk *[/b] to multiply and a [b]forward slash /[/b] to divide. 

Again, we just enter it straight into the [b]print [/b]statement. Like this:
[code format="py" codeId="3161"]print( 10 / 2 ) [/code]
Just like in regular math, we can use [b]parentheses [/b]to indicate the operations we want performed first (but we still need to include the ones around the statement too!). Like this:
[code format="py" codeId="3162"]print( 2 * (3 + 4) ) [/code]
[note]Using a single slash to divide numbers produces a decimal (or [b]float[/b], as it’s known in programming). We'll dive into [b]floats [/b]in the next lesson.[/note]

resolved.title: 时间换算
resolved.problem_statement_md:
有没有想过，一个月（30天）有多少秒？
请写一个程序来计算并输出答案。
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Simple Operations[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

Ever wondered how many seconds are there in a month (30 days)? 

Write a program to calculate and output the answer.

[note]Remember, there are 24 hours in a day, 60 minutes in an hour, and 60 seconds in a minute.
Use the [b]print[/b]() statement to output the result.[/note]
resolved.hint_md:
1. 一天有24小时，一小时有60分钟，一分钟有60秒。
2. 使用**print**()语句来输出结果。
